title: Hp500Backbone
description: Catalog row hp500-backbone 1.0.1: the calibrated engine evaluated on each of the ten HP500 surveys, written by data-pipeline/pipeline/hp500/backbone.py to data/derived/hp500/backbone.json. The engine is the canonical Python engine (pipeline.model.crusher) with calibrated true, the survey's measured closed-side setting and f80, and the HP500 nominal throw and speed; the measured block repeats the survey row. Derived from data licensed CC BY 4.0 (Rocha, Campos, Silva and Tavares 2024, https://doi.org/10.3390/min14090919). Rules the schema cannot state, checked by the producer test: n equals the number of surveys and the surveys are numbered 1 to n in order.

source.description: The source publication of the surveys (Rocha, Campos, Silva and Tavares 2024), as the survey reader states it.

engine_version.description: The product version that wrote the document (format X.XX.XXX); a version other than VERSION makes the row stale.

note.description: What the backbone is: the canonical engine with the HP500 calibration at each survey's measured setting and f80, the nominal throw and speed.

id.description: The case identifier of the survey, HP500-01 to HP500-10.

power_kw.description: Crusher power estimated from the measured current [kW].

measured.description: The survey row as the hp500-survey contract accepted it.

p80_mm.description: The engine's product 80 percent passing size, a model output (the paper's size curves are figures only) [mm].

throughput_tph.description: The engine's capacity at the survey's setting, with the capacity base QT = 647 t/h [t/h].

bond_power_kw.description: Bond's power draw of the engine's throughput, f80 and P80 at the blend work index (9.0 kWh/t) [kW].

calibrated_power_kw.description: The paper's power form Pc = 1.30 Pd + 110 applied to the Bond draw above [kW].

f80_model_mm.description: The feed f80 the engine reads on its sieve grid (the grid truncates the feed's top size) [mm].

backbone.description: The calibrated engine's outputs at the survey's operating point, rounded to two decimals.

surveys.description: The calibrated engine on each survey, in survey order.

paper.description: Authors, year and title of the source publication.

doi.description: The DOI of the source publication.

license.description: The licence of the source data, which the derived document carries.

table.description: The table of the source publication the survey rows are transcribed from.
